title: key_auth plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `key_auth` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component KeyAuthConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

key_location.description: Exact credential location (header:<name> or query:<name>), or an ordered array of 1 to 8 such locations. Locations are evaluated in order; credentials present in two different configured locations are refused with 401 as ambiguous, even when their values match. Repeated locations count once (header names are case-insensitive; query names are case-sensitive). Whitespace is not trimmed; header names must be valid HTTP tokens, and query names must be non-empty and contain no whitespace. A query name that also appears as a `;`-separated sub-parameter (`carrier=;api_key=k`, raw or percent/form-decoded) is ambiguous: the request is refused with 401 and the alias never authenticates. Every configured header name is always removed from client request trailers.

hide_credentials.description: Remove every configured API-key header and query parameter before forwarding an authenticated request upstream, including when another mechanism wins a multi-auth chain. For each query location this also removes a `;`-separated sub-parameter alias. Disable only when a legacy backend explicitly requires the reusable credential.
